title: docs(dev-novel): add tabs to switch between kinds of stories
body: This PR adds tabs on top of dev-novel so that we can easily switch between the different kinds of stories: built-in widgets, connectors + jQuery, unmountable widgets. Those stories were there, but you had to know the URL in order to access them. It is [available on the preview](https://deploy-preview-2947--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=Analytics.default)
